hints: Substitute $\theta$ into the perimeter formula $P = 2r + r\theta$.
walkthrough:
Use the sector area formula $A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta$ to express the central angle $\theta$ in radians:
$$\theta = \frac{2A}{r^2}$$

Write the formula for the perimeter of a circular sector:
$$\text{Perimeter} = r + r + r\theta = 2r + r\theta$$

Substitute $\theta = \frac{2A}{r^2}$ into the perimeter formula and simplify:
$$\text{Perimeter} = 2r + r\left(\frac{2A}{r^2}\right) = 2r + \frac{2A}{r}\text{ cm}$$

ai_rubric.Perimeter and Area of Sector: Uses area formula to find $\theta = \frac{2A}{r^2}$ (M1, A1). Uses perimeter formula $P = 2r + r\theta$ (B1). Obtains $P = 2r + \frac{2A}{r}$ (A1).
